altPaidOutFormula: noninterest expense 12.462 − D&A 1.362 − stock comp 0.317 + income taxes paid 1.575 (USD billions)
notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0000316709-26-000009). Broker with a bank (Charles Schwab Bank): operating cash flow is driven by client receivables and payables and segregated investments, not by revenue collection, so paidOut is null and altPaidOut = noninterest expense − D&A − SBC + income taxes paid (PAIDOUT.md). D&A is both income-statement lines inside total expenses excluding interest: depreciation and amortization (850) and amortization of acquired intangible assets (512). Interest paid (4,557) is shown separately. Capex (548) is recorded for reference and is not in altPaidOut. Revenue is net of interest expense (3,754). Income taxes paid are net of refunds, from the income-tax note.
